scope: Continuation of ten existing number-theory report topics. This records local pre-publication evidence, selected completed proofs, and remaining external inputs; it does not assert complete proofs of all ten research reports.

inventory.finalSourceHashes: research/icm2026-number-theory.json notes; refreshed after integration and formatting. Agent-local checkpoints describe their earlier pre-formatting review state.

sourceChecks.lexicalScope: The scanner still uses the October 12 historical decision register. Candidate counts are not missing-definition counts; newer decisions are described below and in the first-integration verification record.

generatedChecks.scope: Structure, reachability, registered prerequisites and formula parsing; mathematical correctness and semantic atomicity additionally require reading.

computationExpansion.storageScope: Logical stored product-node bits, not measured JavaScript heap or fast-arithmetic workspaces.

reproducibleFiniteTests.scope: Finite numerical and exact-integer regressions check signs, examples and algorithmic invariants. They do not prove general asymptotic bounds or research theorems.
